newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Foreign interest pushes Romania OTC market up.
newsitem.headline: Foreign interest pushes Romania OTC market up.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market ended firmer on Thursday with foreign investors concentrating on heavy-weights, especially oil companies, traders said.
Operators said oil refineries had been in the focus of buying. Cement makers were also in strong demand, but supply was thin.
Traders expected the present rally to extend on Friday and to continue early next week.
Gainers outnumbered losers by 170 to 79, and 315 stocks stayed flat.
Three independent indices computed by securities companies based on average prices and market capitalisation climbed from the previous session.
The VAB-RA all-share index rose by 3.8 percent to 5,420.9 points, BIG-OTC went up 4.24 percent to 4,332.93 and CAS-RQ grew 4.8 percent to 984 points.
Petrobrazi oil refinery, one of the investors' darlings, gained 1,500 lei and closed at 53,000. Another oil refinery, Arpechim, closed also 1,500 lei firmer at 41,500.
Cement maker Romcim closed 2,500 lei up to 132,500.
Rubber products maker Rolast was one of the most heavily traded stocks on Thursday, with more than 1.07 million shares changing hands. It closed 500 lei up at 2,000.
Turnover fell to 28.5 billion lei on Thursday, from 32.3 billion lei previously, while volume grow at 6.1 million from 5.3 million.
